name: Adagio
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
description: A flock of animated paper birds flit about to the playful sounds of an invisible flute, played by the invisible janni Mehryar.
disable: DC 23 Crafting check (trained) to create beautiful flying objects to complement the paper birds; DC 25 Acrobatics check or DC 22 Performance check (DC 18 Performance check if using a flute) (trained) to perform along with the flute and paper birds (requires two successes); or one successful attack roll against the Invisible Mehryar (AC 23, DC 23 Perception check to determine Mehryar's location)
reset: The trap deactivates and resets if no hostile creatures remain outside.
routine: (3 actions) On each of the trap's actions, the flock of paper birds attacks a different creature. On a successful hit, each target must attempt a DC 23 Reflex save. On a failure, they take 1d6 persistent plus bleed damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sforzando
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the museum door without Fasiel's permission

Effect The trap rolls initiative as the paper birds attack. Wind and rain flurry through the area, applying a –2 circumstance penalty to ranged attacks and Perception checks, extinguishing non-magical fire, and impeding spells and abilities with the fire trait. Casters must succeed at a DC 6 Flat check or the action is disrupted.
